title: Velocity
coreMove: Judge motion by direction as well as pace, and stop rewarding speed that carries you away from the target.
sourcePressure: Velocity is speed plus direction; fast movement can be misleading if the heading is wrong.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: celebrating urgency, hustle, or fast execution as progress by default

hook: opening with a definition of Velocity
counterintuition: celebrating urgency, hustle, or fast execution as progress by default
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof
